definitions.explanation: The gradual change or development of something over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧。
examples.english: To watch the trend of stock prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注視|ちゅうし}→注視：16389_chuushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{推移|すいい} refers to gradual change or development over time. It emphasizes the process of transition rather than sudden change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推移|すいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch trends
- {推移|すいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to follow developments
- {推移|すいい}⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: trend graph
- {推移|すいい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transition, change over time

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}: population trends
- ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}: price trends
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推移|すいい}: passage of time, changing of eras

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: change (general, can be sudden or gradual)
- {推移|すいい}: transition (gradual, over time, data-oriented)
- ⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧: trends, movements (broader scope, future-looking)

REGISTER:
Formal; frequently seen in news articles, reports, and academic writing.
